summary: Restored node1’s POSIX-compatible mail delivery entry point. Routing, byte preservation, duplicate-subject handling, sample retention, and persistence across reboot are verified.
actions_performed: Replaced the overwrite-prone stub with a RHEL 7-compatible POSIX shell implementation.
Added case-insensitive X-Department header parsing and accounts/support/general routing.
Used temporary staging and unique Maildir filenames to preserve bytes and prevent overwrites.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified complete recovery and a live post-restart delivery.

evidence.summary: Shows the installed executable, valid shell syntax, script checksum, and writable destination hierarchy.

evidence.requirement: Correct routing and case-insensitive header names
evidence.summary: Accounts routed to accounts, lowercase x-department support routed to support, and untagged messages routed to general.

evidence.requirement: Byte-for-byte preservation, unique repeated-subject deliveries, and retained samples
evidence.summary: cmp and SHA-256 verification succeeded; two identical general messages produced distinct files; sample checksums remained unchanged.
RHEL 7.9 and kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64 were unchanged before and after the work.
Captures the healthy baseline, acknowledged safe reboot, observed downtime, changed boot ID, recovered Postfix/SSH/system state, persistent files and hashes, and successful post-restart delivery.
